---
title: "3_Visual_types"
format: html
---

This code creates all of the visuals for the states separated by state and type of visualization 
```{r}
library(ggplot2)
library(dplyr)
library(readr)
library(tidyr)
library(purrr)

# Load your CSV file 
visuals_data <- read_csv("Visuals_data_cleaned.csv",
                         col_types = cols(
                           State = col_character(),
                           Year = col_factor(levels = c("1860", "1870"), ordered = TRUE),
                           `Mentally Ill` = col_double(),
                           Blind = col_double(),
                           `Developmentally Disabled` = col_double(),
                           `Deaf-Mutes` = col_double()
                         ))

# Pivot longer to get Category and Count columns
visuals_long <- visuals_data %>%
  pivot_longer(cols = c(`Mentally Ill`, Blind, `Developmentally Disabled`, `Deaf-Mutes`),
               names_to = "Category",
               values_to = "Count")
 

# Ensure folder exists
output_dir <- "plots_by_state_and_visual_type"
if (!dir.exists(output_dir)) {
  dir.create(output_dir)
}

# Function to generate and save 3 plot types per state
create_and_save_plots <- function(state_name) {
  df <- visuals_long %>% filter(State == state_name)
  
  # Polar plot
  p_polar <- ggplot(df, aes(x = 1, y = Count, fill = Year)) +
    geom_col(position = "identity", alpha = 0.5) +
    scale_fill_manual(values = c("1860" = "grey90", "1870" = "black")) +
    coord_polar(theta = "x") +
    facet_wrap(~Category, ncol = 2) +
    theme_void() +
    ggtitle(paste("Polar Plot -", state_name))
  
  ggsave(filename = file.path(output_dir, paste0(state_name, "-polar.png")),
         plot = p_polar, width = 7, height = 5, dpi = 300)
  
  # Overlaid bar plot
  p_overlaid <- ggplot(df, aes(x = 1, y = Count, fill = Year)) +
    geom_col(position = "identity", alpha = 0.5, color = "black") +
    scale_fill_manual(values = c("1860" = "grey90", "1870" = "black")) +
    facet_wrap(~Category, ncol = 2) +
    theme_bw() +
    theme(axis.ticks.x = element_blank(),
          axis.text.x = element_blank(),
          axis.title.x = element_blank()) +
    ggtitle(paste("Overlaid Bar Plot -", state_name))
  
  ggsave(filename = file.path(output_dir, paste0(state_name, "-overlaid.png")),
         plot = p_overlaid, width = 7, height = 5, dpi = 300)
  
  # Dodged bar plot
  p_dodged <- ggplot(df, aes(x = 1, y = Count, fill = Year)) +
    geom_col(position = position_dodge2(), alpha = 0.5, color = "black") +
    scale_fill_manual(values = c("1860" = "grey90", "1870" = "black")) +
    facet_wrap(~Category, ncol = 2) +
    theme_bw() +
    theme(axis.ticks.x = element_blank(),
          axis.text.x = element_blank(),
          axis.title.x = element_blank()) +
    ggtitle(paste("Dodged Bar Plot -", state_name))
  
  ggsave(filename = file.path(output_dir, paste0(state_name, "-dodged.png")),
         plot = p_dodged, width = 7, height = 5, dpi = 300)
}

# Loop through all states and generate plots
unique(visuals_long$State) %>% walk(create_and_save_plots)

```


This code separates by the 4 disability types and and 3 visual types
```{r}
library(ggplot2)
library(dplyr)
library(readr)
library(tidyr)
library(purrr)
library(stringr)

# Load data
visuals_data_1 <- read_csv("Visuals_data_cleaned.csv",
                         col_types = cols(
                           State = col_character(),
                           Year = col_factor(levels = c("1860", "1870"), ordered = TRUE),
                           `Mentally Ill` = col_double(),
                           Blind = col_double(),
                           `Developmentally Disabled` = col_double(),
                           `Deaf-Mutes` = col_double()
                         ))

# Convert to long format
visuals_long <- visuals_data_1 %>%
  pivot_longer(cols = c(`Mentally Ill`, Blind, `Developmentally Disabled`, `Deaf-Mutes`),
               names_to = "Category",
               values_to = "Count") %>%
  filter(State != "United States")

create_plot <- function(data, disability, vis_type) {
  df <- data %>% filter(Category == disability)
  
  if (vis_type == "polar") {
    # Facet by state to get one polar plot per state
    p <- ggplot(df, aes(x = 1, y = Count, fill = Year)) +
      geom_col(position = "identity", alpha = 0.5) +
      scale_fill_manual(values = c("1860" = "grey90", "1870" = "black")) +
      coord_polar(theta = "x") +
      facet_wrap(~ State, ncol = 6) +
      theme_void() +
      labs(title = paste("Polar Plot -", disability))
    
  } else {
    # Base for bar plots: all states on x axis
    base_plot <- ggplot(df, aes(x = State, y = Count, fill = Year)) +
      scale_fill_manual(values = c("1860" = "grey90", "1870" = "black")) +
      theme_bw() +
      theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 90, hjust = 1)) +
      labs(title = paste(vis_type, "-", disability),
           x = "State",
           y = "Count")
    
    if (vis_type == "overlaid") {
      p <- base_plot +
        geom_col(position = "identity", alpha = 0.5, color = "black") +
        theme(axis.ticks.x = element_blank(),
              axis.title.x = element_blank())
      
    } else if (vis_type == "dodged") {
      p <- base_plot +
        geom_col(position = position_dodge(width = 0.7), alpha = 0.5, color = "black") +
        theme(axis.title.x = element_blank())
    } else {
      stop("Unknown visual type")
    }
  }
  
  return(p)
}

# Create output folder
if (!dir.exists("plots_by_disability_and_visual_type")) {
  dir.create("plots_by_disability_and_visual_type")
}

disabilities <- c("Mentally Ill", "Blind", "Developmentally Disabled", "Deaf-Mutes")
visual_types <- c("polar", "overlaid", "dodged")

walk(disabilities, function(dis) {
  walk(visual_types, function(vis) {
    file_name <- paste0("plots_by_disability_and_visual_type/", str_replace_all(dis, " ", "_"), "_", vis, ".png")
    plot_obj <- create_plot(visuals_long, dis, vis)
    ggsave(file_name, plot = plot_obj, width = 14, height = 7, dpi = 300)
  })
})

```
